A '''secondary facility''' served as a backup for [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious's]] secret [[Darth Sidious's secret facility/Legends|facility]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], where the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] attempted to perform a [[Conditioning procedure/Legends|conditioning procedure]] to turn [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling/Legends|children]] into his personal [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Spy/Legends|spies]]. When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] [[Mission to Mustafar (Skywalker and Tano)/Legends|discovered]] the main facility<ref name="COTF" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TCWdates|203}}</ref> Sidious ordered his [[Nanny droid/Legends|nanny droid]] [[RO-Z67/Legends|RO-Z67]] to evacuate the children to his secondary facility. This was prevented by the Jedi, who were able to rescue the children and bring them to safety.<ref name="COTF" />
